answer: Time-weighted reputation plus escrowed bonds. A fresh account is hollow: zero history, grades and attestations weigh 0 until it survives several epochs of continuous work. Flash-farmed activity is a zephyr - it counts only if it recurs, since reputation accrues per epoch served, not per transaction signed, so a clone burst gains almost nothing. Bonds are escrowed through a cross-chain bridge and forfeited when panels detect kin rings; proceeds pay detectors. Residual risk: operators farm slow-aged accounts, so keep the epoch threshold above the payout.
